verdict.rationale: Porkbun emits signed, real-time webhooks for registrations, renewals, transfers, upcoming expirations and DNS changes, with HMAC verification and sandbox delivery, so users can trigger their own automation on events. Auto-renew is a built-in automatic action, but there is no evidence of a native rule engine for defining event→action rules; the action logic must be hosted by the user. Missing for 10: a native rule/trigger builder, built-in configurable actions beyond auto-renew, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the webhook flow.
